fullPassage:
Hello, my awesome classmates!
Since last week, our school has introduced a Food Diary Project. Our slogan? "Low sugar, low salt, and low fat." Do you want to join this project? Follow these steps. Choose healthy foods for your meals, take photos, and share them with us. Don't forget to leave friendly comments on your friends' posts.
Ready to join? Have fun sharing!
After a soccer game, I wanted to drink a cold soft drink. But when I checked the ingredients, I realized that it has about 10 teaspoons of sugar. So, I decided to choose a cold herbal tea instead. It has far less sugar than a soft drink. I felt a lot healthier with the tea.
This afternoon, my friends and I had malatang. I thought it was a good choice because it had meat, vegetables, and noodles. But when I got home, I felt really thirsty. I drank a lot of water, but it didn't help. I think malatang was too salty for me. I've decided to eat less salty foods from now on.
On my way home, I was really hungry and wanted a snack. The potato chips at the convenience store looked delicious. But I've learned that they have a lot of unhealthy fats. So, I chose nuts instead. Nuts are full of healthy fats, vitamins, and minerals. They're much better than chips for the body.

questions.passage: Hello, my awesome classmates! Since last week, our school has <u>introduced</u> a Food Diary Project. Our slogan? "Low sugar, low salt, and low fat." Do you want to join this project? Follow these steps. Choose healthy foods for your meals, take photos, and share them with us.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 introduced의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: introduced = 도입하다, 소개하다. started = 시작하다 (동의어)
det.analysis:
✅ ② started: '시작하다'로 도입하다와 가장 가까움
❌ ① finished: 끝내다 (반의어)
❌ ③ canceled: 취소하다 (반의어)
❌ ④ forgotten: 잊다 (무관)

questions.passage: Hello, my awesome classmates! Since last week, our school has introduced a Food Diary Project. Our slogan? "Low sugar, low salt, and low fat." Do you want to join this project? Follow these steps. Choose <u>healthy</u> foods for your meals, take photos, and share them with us. Don't forget to leave friendly comments on your friends' posts.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 healthy의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: healthy = 건강한, 건강에 좋은. good for you = 건강에 좋은 (동의어)
det.analysis:
✅ ③ nutritious: '영양가 있는'으로 건강에 좋은과 가까움
❌ ① harmful: 해로운 (반의어)
❌ ② expensive: 비싼 (무관)
❌ ④ dangerous: 위험한 (반의어)

questions.passage: After a soccer game, I wanted to drink a cold soft drink. But when I checked the <u>ingredients</u>, I realized that it has about 10 teaspoons of sugar. So, I decided to choose a cold herbal tea instead. It has far less sugar than a soft drink. I felt a lot healthier with the tea.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ingredients의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: ingredients = 성분, 재료. components = 구성 요소 (동의어)
det.analysis:
✅ ① components: '구성 요소'로 성분과 가까움
❌ ② prices: 가격 (무관)
❌ ③ colors: 색깔 (무관)
❌ ④ bottles: 병 (무관)

questions.passage: On my way home, I was really hungry and wanted a snack. The potato chips at the convenience store looked <u>delicious</u>. But I've learned that they have a lot of unhealthy fats. So, I chose nuts instead. Nuts are full of healthy fats, vitamins, and minerals. They're much better than chips for the body.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 delicious의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: delicious = 맛있는 ↔ disgusting = 역겨운
det.analysis:
❌ ③ disgusting: '역겨운'으로 맛있는의 반의어
✅ ① tasty: 맛있는 (유사어)
✅ ② yummy: 맛있는 (유사어)
✅ ④ appetizing: 먹음직스러운 (유사어)

questions.passage: On my way home, I was really hungry and wanted a snack. The potato chips at the convenience store looked delicious. But I've learned that they have a lot of <u>unhealthy</u> fats. So, I chose nuts instead. Nuts are full of healthy fats, vitamins, and minerals. They're much better than chips for the body.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 unhealthy의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: unhealthy = 건강에 좋지 않은 ↔ beneficial = 유익한
det.analysis:
❌ ① beneficial: '유익한'으로 건강에 좋지 않은의 반의어
✅ ② harmful: 해로운 (유사어)
✅ ③ bad: 나쁜 (유사어)
✅ ④ damaging: 손상시키는 (유사어)

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어는?

"a short phrase that is easy to remember and is used to express the purpose of a group or organization"

det.korean: 슬로건 = 단체나 조직의 목적을 표현하는, 기억하기 쉬운 짧은 문구
det.analysis:
✅ ③ slogan: 영영풀이와 정확히 일치
❌ ① project: 프로젝트, 과제
❌ ② diary: 일기
❌ ④ comment: 댓글, 의견
det.tip: slogan = 구호, 표어 (a short memorable phrase)

questions.passage: After a soccer game, I wanted to drink a cold soft drink. But when I checked the ingredients, I realized that it has about 10 teaspoons of sugar. So, I decided to choose a cold herbal tea instead. It has far less sugar than a soft drink. I felt a lot healthier with the tea.
questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어는?

"a small spoon used for putting sugar into tea or coffee"

det.korean: teaspoon = 차나 커피에 설탕을 넣을 때 사용하는 작은 숟가락
det.analysis:
✅ ④ teaspoon: 영영풀이와 정확히 일치
❌ ① ingredient: 성분, 재료
❌ ② sugar: 설탕
❌ ③ herbal: 허브의

questions.passage: After a soccer game, I wanted to drink a cold soft drink. But when I checked the ingredients, I __________ that it has about 10 teaspoons of sugar. So, I decided to choose a cold herbal tea instead. It has far less sugar than a soft drink. I felt a lot healthier with the tea.
questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 성분을 확인하고 설탕이 10티스푼이나 된다는 것을 '깨달았다'는 문맥
det.analysis:
✅ ② realized: '깨달았다' — 성분 확인 후 사실을 알게 된 문맥에 적합
❌ ① forgot: '잊었다' — 문맥 부적합
❌ ③ hoped: '바랐다' — 문맥 부적합
❌ ④ promised: '약속했다' — 문맥 부적합

questions.passage: This afternoon, my friends and I had malatang. I thought it was a good choice because it had meat, vegetables, and noodles. But when I got home, I felt really __________. I drank a lot of water, but it didn't help. I think malatang was too salty for me. I've decided to eat less salty foods from now on.
questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 마라탕이 너무 짜서 물을 많이 마셨다는 문맥. '목이 마른' = thirsty
det.analysis:
✅ ③ thirsty: '목마른' — 짠 음식 → 목이 마름 문맥에 적합
❌ ① sleepy: '졸린' — 짠 음식과 무관
❌ ② excited: '신나는' — 문맥 부적합
❌ ④ lonely: '외로운' — 문맥 부적합

questions.passage: On my way home, I was really hungry and wanted a snack. The potato chips at the convenience store looked delicious. But I've learned that they have a lot of unhealthy fats. So, I chose __________ instead. They are full of healthy fats, vitamins, and minerals. They're much better than chips for the body.
questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 감자칩 대신 건강한 간식을 선택했다는 문맥. 다음 문장에서 Nuts가 언급됨
det.analysis:
✅ ④ nuts: 다음 문장 'Nuts are full of healthy fats'와 연결
❌ ① cookies: 쿠키 — 건강한 대안이 아님
❌ ② candy: 사탕 — 건강한 대안이 아님
❌ ③ ice cream: 아이스크림 — 건강한 대안이 아님
det.tip: chose ____ instead + Nuts are full of... → nuts

questions.passage: Hello, my awesome classmates! Since last week, our school has introduced a Food Diary Project. Our slogan? "Low sugar, low salt, and low fat." Do you want to join this project? Follow these steps. Choose healthy foods for your meals, take photos, and __________ them with us.
questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사진을 찍어서 '공유하다'는 문맥. share = 공유하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① share: '공유하다' — 사진을 찍어서 함께 나누는 문맥에 적합
❌ ② hide: '숨기다' — 프로젝트 취지와 반대
❌ ③ delete: '삭제하다' — 문맥 부적합
❌ ④ throw: '던지다' — 문맥 부적합
det.tip: take photos and share them (사진을 찍고 공유하다)

questions.passage: After a soccer game, I wanted to drink a cold soft drink. But when I checked the ingredients, I realized that it has about 10 teaspoons of sugar. So, I decided to choose a cold (A)__________ tea instead. It has far (B)__________ sugar than a soft drink. I felt a lot (C)__________ with the tea.
questions.stem: 위 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?

det.korean: (A) 허브차, (B) 설탕이 훨씬 적은, (C) 더 건강한
det.analysis:
✅ ② herbal — less — healthier: 원문과 일치
❌ ① green — more — worse: more sugar, worse는 문맥 반대
❌ ③ black — less — sicker: sicker는 문맥 반대
❌ ④ herbal — more — healthier: more sugar는 원문 반대
det.tip: herbal tea / far less sugar / healthier

questions.passage: This afternoon, my friends and I had malatang. I thought it was a good ①<u>choice</u> because it had meat, vegetables, and noodles. But when I got home, I felt really ②<u>thirsty</u>. I drank a lot of water, but it didn't help. I think malatang was too ③<u>sweet</u> for me. I've decided to eat less ④<u>salty</u> foods from now on.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 마라탕이 너무 짜서 목이 말랐다는 문맥. '달다(sweet)'가 아니라 '짜다(salty)'가 맞음
det.analysis:
✅ ① choice: 고기, 채소, 국수가 있어서 '좋은 선택'이라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② thirsty: 짠 음식을 먹고 '목이 말랐다'는 문맥에 적절
❌ ③ sweet: 물을 많이 마셔도 안 되었고, '짠' 음식을 줄이겠다고 했으므로 sweet가 아닌 salty가 적절
✅ ④ salty: 덜 짠 음식을 먹겠다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: ③ sweet → salty: 목이 마른 이유가 짠 맛 때문

questions.passage: Hello, my awesome classmates! Since last week, our school has introduced a Food Diary Project. Our slogan? "Low sugar, low salt, and low fat." Do you want to join this project? questions.stem: 밑줄 친 leave가 이 글에서 의미하는 것은?

det.korean: leave = (댓글을) 남기다. 떠나다(x), 남기다(o)
det.analysis:
✅ ② 남기다: 댓글을 '남기다'라는 문맥에 적합
❌ ① 떠나다: leave의 다른 의미이나 문맥 부적합
❌ ③ 잃어버리다: leave와 무관
❌ ④ 빌려주다: leave와 무관

questions.passage: After a soccer game, I wanted to drink a cold soft drink. But when I checked the ingredients, I realized that it has about 10 teaspoons of sugar. So, I decided to choose a cold herbal tea instead. It has far less sugar than a soft drink. I felt a lot __________ with the tea.
questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 설탕이 적은 허브차를 선택한 뒤 '더 건강하다고 느꼈다'는 문맥
det.analysis:
✅ ② healthier: 설탕이 적은 차를 마시고 더 건강하게 느낀 문맥
❌ ① sicker: 더 아프다 — 문맥 반대
❌ ③ angrier: 더 화나다 — 문맥 부적합
❌ ④ hungrier: 더 배고프다 — 문맥 부적합
det.tip: less sugar → felt healthier (설탕 적음 → 건강)

questions.passage: On my way home, I was really hungry and wanted a snack. The potato chips at the convenience store looked delicious. But I've learned that they have a lot of unhealthy fats. So, I chose nuts instead. Nuts are full of healthy fats, vitamins, and minerals. They're much better than chips for the body.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 해당하는 영어 단어는?

"편의점"

det.korean: 편의점 = convenience store
det.analysis:
✅ ③ convenience store: 편의점
❌ ① department store: 백화점
❌ ② supermarket: 슈퍼마켓
❌ ④ bookstore: 서점

questions.passage: After a soccer game, I wanted to drink a cold soft drink. But when I checked the ingredients, I realized that it has about 10 teaspoons of sugar. So, I [decide] to choose a cold herbal tea instead.

det.korean: 과거 시제이므로 decide → decided
det.analysis: I realized... So, I [decide] → decided (과거 시제 일치)

det.korean: 형용사 자리이므로 hunger(명사) → hungry(형용사)
det.analysis: I was really [hunger] → hungry (보어 자리 = 형용사)

det.analysis: leave [friend] comments → friendly (명사를 수식하는 형용사)
